newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish 1996 grain harvest rated above average.
newsitem.headline: Danish 1996 grain harvest rated above average.

text.p: Denmark's 1996 grain harvest was rated overall "above average" in a preliminary survey by the national statistics office released on Tuesday.

The report said this year's grain harvest was 14 percent above the average for the 1993-95 period but rape was 32 percent lower. Compared with 1995, grain production was up four percent, while rape was down 20 percent.

It said set-aside fields had been reduced in 1996, giving grain growing areas in Denmark some eight percent up on 1995 at a total of 1,575,000 hectares. But it attributed the fall in rape production to a 30 percent smaller area. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
